sloka: एष ते विस्तरो राम शैल पुत्र्या निवेदितः ।गन्गायाः प्रभवम् चैव शृणु मे सह लक्ष्मण ॥१-३६-२६॥
transliteration: eṣa te vistaro rāma śaila putryā niveditaḥ ।gangāyāḥ prabhavam caiva śṛṇu me saha lakṣmaṇa ॥1-36-26॥

translations.english: "Mahesvara along with goddess Uma, went north of the Himavat mountain and performed penance on a peak.
